newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent and gas oil futures weaker with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent and gas oil futures weaker with NYMEX.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures continued to forge fresh session lows as weaker U.S. product futures dragged the whole NYMEX complex lower, traders said.
By 1501 GMT the November Brent contract had broken through initial support at $21.99 a barrel, Wednesday's low, traded down to $21.90 before correcting to $21.97, off a net 34 cents.
Traders said the that while the November contract remained supported by the $21.45-$21 gap to the downside they expected prices to drift lower without more support from products.
October gas oil was holding around initial support at $215 a tonne, down $3.50 on the day.
The weaker product futures saw crack spreads contract a little with the Nov gas oil/Brent narrowing around 13 points to 5.92 cents a barrel by 1514 GMT.

Traders said prices were falling in fairly thin volume with little fresh news to stir buying interest although some expected the low distillate inventories in Europe and the United States to continue to underpin the market in the longer term.
"The falls in London and New York were mainly on profit taking. There's some more upside to come," a trader said. "The fundamentals, particularly for distillates, are good."
